Write the whole-module specification

Read input: origen_028865.v · Open raw
module origen_028865 (
    input wire clock,
    input wire vsync,
    input wire href,
    input wire [7:0] data,
    output reg p_valid,
    output reg [23:0] p_data,
    output reg f_done
);

    reg [1:0] state;
    reg [1:0] axis;
    reg [7:0] u, v, y0, y1;

    always @(posedge clock) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin // Idle state
                f_done <= 1'b0;
                p_valid <= 1'b0;
                axis <= 2'b00;
                if (!vsync) state <= 2'b01;
            end
            2'b01: begin // Active state
                if (vsync) begin
                    f_done <= 1'b1;
                    state <= 2'b00;
                end else begin
                    f_done <= 1'b0;
                    if (href) begin
                        case (axis)
                            2'b00: u <= data;
                            2'b01: y0 <= data;
                            2'b10: v <= data;
                            2'b11: y1 <= data;
                        endcase
                        axis <= axis + 1'b1;
                        p_valid <= axis[0];
                    end else begin
                        p_valid <= 1'b0;
                    end
                end
            end
        endcase
    end

    always @(*) begin
        if (axis[0]) begin
            p_data = {y1, u, v};
        end else begin
            p_data = {y0, u, v};
        end
    end

endmodule
